comments:
Answering to 'Jig rten mgon po's (1143-1217) question about the best teachers in dBus, mGo zla pandita lists "g.Yor" along with "Phya" - Phya pa (ID:3831) - "Nyams" or "Nyang" - Nyang bran Chos kyi seng ge (ID:3844) or Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876) - gTsang nag pa (ID:3839) and Dan bag pa (ID:3840) as examples of teachers of "mtshan nyid." ([7RUF6F47]: 78, n. 58)
The "dge bshes g.yor nyag" mentioned by rTa tshag Tshe dbang rgyal in his ecclesiastic history as a teacher of epistemology is probably the same person.
